# Honor

Honor is how the whole kingdom regards you, for deeds done for Wonder Kingdom rather than for one town or one person. It is earned only from deeds the game names (a boss's first clear, a town's story, great milestones), never per kill, and it is never lost. It goes up to 10,000.

| Rank | Points | You are |
|---|---|---|
| Citizen | 0 | a citizen of the kingdom |
| Steadfast | 500 | Steadfast, someone the kingdom can count on |
| Defender | 1,500 | a Defender of the Kingdom |
| Champion | 4,000 | a Champion of the Kingdom |
| Hero of the Kingdom | 8,000 | a Hero of the Kingdom |
